API-003 and API-010 do not set the 400 and 422 split, so EXTRA stands. Force agreed.

Both subclauses are DEFAULT, the force the reader gave, and no policy entails them.
Other cited ranges state and enforce it: check-instructions errors when a rule sits outside a level directory or has no paths. The first range misled the reader.
